In LaTeX, you can left-align the caption of a table without using the `caption` package by redefining the `\@makecaption` command for tables. Here's how you can do it:

### Method 1: Using `\captionsetup` (if you later decide to use `caption` package)
*(Not what you asked, but included for completeness.)*
```latex
\usepackage{caption}
\captionsetup[table]{justification=raggedright,singlelinecheck=false}
```

### Method 2: Redefining `\@makecaption` (No `caption` package)
Add the following to your preamble (before `\begin{document}`):

```latex
\makeatletter
\long\def\@makecaption#1#2{%
  \vskip\abovecaptionskip
  \sbox\@tempboxa{#1: #2}%
  \ifdim \wd\@tempboxa >\hsize
    \noindent\hspace{\leftmargini}#1: #2\par % Left-align if caption is long
  \else
    \global \@minipagefalse
    \hb@xt@\hsize{\hfil\box\@tempboxa\hfil}% Center if short (default behavior)
  \fi
  \vskip\belowcaptionskip}
\makeatother
```

### Method 3: Force Left-Alignment for All Captions
If you want **all** table captions to be left-aligned (ignoring the default single-line centering), use:

```latex
\makeatletter
\long\def\@makecaption#1#2{%
  \vskip\abovecaptionskip
  \sbox\@tempboxa{#1: #2}%
  \ifdim \wd\@tempboxa >\hsize
    \noindent\hspace{\leftmargini}#1: #2\par % Left-align long captions
  \else
    \noindent\hspace{\leftmargini}#1: #2\par % Force left-align even for short captions
  \fi
  \vskip\belowcaptionskip}
\makeatother
```

### Example Usage
```latex
\documentclass{article}

% Add the redefinition here (Method 2 or 3)
\makeatletter
\long\def\@makecaption#1#2{%
  \vskip\abovecaptionskip
  \sbox\@tempboxa{#1: #2}%
  \ifdim \wd\@tempboxa >\hsize
    \noindent\hspace{\leftmargini}#1: #2\par
  \else
    \noindent\hspace{\leftmargini}#1: #2\par % Force left-align
  \fi
  \vskip\belowcaptionskip}
\makeatother

\begin{document}

\begin{table}[h]
\centering
\begin{tabular}{|c|c|}
\hline
A & B \\ \hline
1 & 2 \\ \hline
\end{tabular}
\caption{This is a left-aligned table caption without the caption package.}
\end{table}

\end{document}
```

### Notes:
- This modifies the default LaTeX caption behavior.
- If you later load the `caption` package, it may override these changes.
- The `\leftmargini` ensures the caption aligns with the left margin of the document. Adjust if needed.
